requirements.item_text: Remote QP certification/confirmation is carried out fully in line with EU legislation and EU GMP guidelines.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: It is a prerequisite that the QP certification/confirmation is carried out in full accordance with EU legislation and EU GMP guidelines

requirements.item_text: In all cases the QP performs certification/confirmation from within the EU/EEA (or Northern Ireland), and the location is demonstrated by technical means.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QP certification / confirmation should take place within the EU/EEA (or Northern Ireland) in all cases. This should be demonstrated by technical means.

requirements.item_text: QPs keep their knowledge of the products, manufacturing processes and pharmaceutical quality system up to date.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs are obliged to maintain their knowledge in relation to the products, manufacturing processes and pharmaceutical quality system.

requirements.item_text: QPs satisfy themselves that their continuing reliance on the relevant pharmaceutical quality system is well founded.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs also need to be satisfied that their ongoing reliance on the relevant pharmaceutical quality system is well founded.

requirements.item_text: The QP can show the competent authority that they know the products and manufacturing processes they are responsible for.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The QP must be able to demonstrate to the competent authority knowledge of the product and the manufacturing processes for which they are responsible.

requirements.item_text: The QP's demonstrated product and process knowledge includes time physically spent on site, as applicable.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: This should include time spent physically on-site as applicable.

requirements.item_text: Where remote QP certification/confirmation is used routinely, it is described and controlled within the pharmaceutical quality system.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: Where remote QP certification / confirmation is employed on a routine basis, it must be described and controlled within the pharmaceutical quality system

requirements.item_text: Where remote QP certification/confirmation is used routinely, detailed site procedures covering it are in place.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: relevant detailed site procedures should be in place

requirements.item_text: In Member States that permit contract QPs, the technical agreement between the MIA holder and the contract QP covers remote certification/confirmation and states when the QP has to attend the site.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: In Member States where use of contract QPs (i.e. a person who is not an employee of the manufacturer but conducting QP activities under the manufacturer’s authorisation) is permitted, the technical agreement between the MIA holder and the QP should also mention remote certification / confirmation, and specify the circumstances under which the QP must attend the site.

requirements.item_text: The QP has access to all data and computer system applications needed under Annex 16 to decide on batch certification/confirmation.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The QP should have access to all information (data and computer system applications) which are necessary according to Annex 16 to make a decision on batch certification / confirmation.

requirements.item_text: The MIA holder provides the facilities, equipment and support QPs need to work remotely, including electronic batch certification/confirmation and remote completion of the batch certification register.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The MIA holder should provide the required facilities to enable QPs to carry out their functions remotely. This includes the equipment and support required to enable electronic batch certification / confirmation and completion of the batch certification register remotely.

requirements.item_text: Every electronic action the QP takes at the remote location is available at the same time for competent authority inspection at the authorised batch release site.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: All actions carried out by the QP electronically at the remote location should be contemporaneously available for inspection by the competent authorities at the authorised batch release site.

requirements.item_text: QPs can show they are fulfilling their wider duties under Annex 16.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs must be able to demonstrate that they are fulfilling their wider duties in accordance with Annex 16.
